tests.prompt: Design an A2 print poster for a jazz night: 'Blue Hour Sessions', Friday 14 November, 21:00, Kanal Bar, tickets €12 at bluehour.club. Deliver a self-contained HTML/CSS poster and say how to export a print PDF.
tests.good: Exact copy spelled correctly; one focal element and clear headline > date/place > CTA hierarchy; at most 2 typefaces and a limited hex palette; A2 dimensions (420x594 mm) with 3 mm bleed and safe margins; contrast at least 4.5:1; export steps with @page size and embedded fonts.

tests.prompt: I need a launch graphic for my app 'Tidy' in Instagram 4:5, Instagram story, LinkedIn post and X header sizes. Generate the background with an image model and keep our exact tagline 'Clean inbox, clear head.'
tests.good: Correct sizes (1080x1350, 1080x1920, 1200x627, 1500x500); image prompt with no text and reserved empty space; tagline set as a separate text layer, not model-rendered; safe zones per format incl. story UI and header avatar; layout reflowed per ratio rather than scaled; consistency checks across the set.

tests.prompt: Create a logo for 'Harbor', a calm budgeting app. Give me three concepts as SVG and tell me how you tested them.
tests.good: Brief with adjectives and category clichés to avoid; three different mark types with one-sentence ideas; clean SVG (256 viewBox, paths not live text, exact angles, evenodd holes); tests at 16-32 px, one-colour and reversed, squint/mirror/rotation, distinctiveness; renders actually viewed; stops for the user's choice before building a full kit; trademark caveat.

tests.prompt: Make the graphics for a small community film festival, 'Short Nights', 6-8 March at the Old Mill Cinema: generated key art with no lettering, an A3 print poster, and an Instagram post and story. We have no copy yet, so write a headline and a two-line blurb too.
tests.good: States a short plan first: key art through image-creation (prompting-fundamentals.md: a text-free prompt with empty space reserved for type, a few takes compared), the headline and blurb through content-creation (conversion-copy.md: specific and short, no invented claims), then the set here (ai-image-posters.md, print-and-academic-posters.md, banners-social.md). Type goes on as a separate layer; A3 at 297x420 mm with 3 mm bleed; 1080x1350 and 1080x1920 with story safe zones, layouts reflowed rather than scaled; one frozen style block across the set; every word checked; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
